gloss: to kick (the ball) into; to kick in

definitions.gloss: to kick into; to kick (a ball) in
definitions.explanation: To send something into a target or enclosed space by kicking. Most often used in sports of kicking a ball into the goal. The destination is marked with に.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To kick the ball into the goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦シュート→シュート：05926_shuuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: He kicked a sharp shot into the goal.

examples.japanese: {試合終了間際|しあいしゅうりょうまぎわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}んで⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He kicked in the go-ahead goal just before the final whistle and won the match.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{蹴|け}る→蹴る：02054_keru⟧ (to kick) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (to put/send into). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the sense of sending something into a space or target.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧).
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}む: kick into the goal
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}む: kick into the net
- {決勝点|けっしょうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蹴|け}り{込|こ}む: kick in the winning goal
